qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the Vee belt pulley on crankshaft?
What screw size and torque is required for the vibration damper hub on crankshaft when replacing screws?
qa_pairs.answer: M20/M21/M50/M52/S50 US/S52 screws with M18 x 1.5 thread, torqued to 410 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for M30/S14/S38 B 35 screws?
What torque angles are specified after the initial torque for the vibration damper?
What is the initial torque before applying torque angles for M41/M51/M60/1/M60/2/M62 screws?
What screw specification is used for M70/S70/M73 engines?
What are the torque angle specifications for M70/S70/M73 engines after initial torque?
What is the torque specification for S38 B36 screws?
What special procedure is mentioned for one of the vibration damper installations?
What are the final torque specifications after unfastening the screw one half turn?
qa_pairs.answer: Initial torque of 60 Nm, followed by torque angles of 60°, 60°, and 30°.
